title: Airy Caramelized Ukrainian Pineapple Skewers
description: A light and festive Ukrainian dish featuring caramelized pineapple, perfect for any occasion. This pescatarian-friendly recipe is easy to make and fun to eat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread pineapple chunks onto the soaked wooden skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the brown sugar, lemon juice, vanilla extract, and salt to the saucepan and stir until the sugar dissolves.
Bring the sugar mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Brush the caramelized sugar mixture onto the pineapple skewers.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 15 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and garnish with chopped fresh mint.
Serve the Airy Caramelized Ukrainian Pineapple Skewers on a talavera plate and enjoy.
